title: Encounter against the signed record: discrepancy report

definition.object: Flag obvious differences between what was said in an encounter and the signed Pulse note for it. A discrepancy report for review: it states no verdict on any person and writes nothing to Pulse.

findings.in_record_not_said: an item in the record with no support on the tape
findings.said_not_in_record: an item said on the tape that the record lacks
findings.value_mismatch: dose, frequency or side differ between record and tape

tiers.obvious: a drug, procedure or non-differential diagnosis in the record with no support on the tape, or a clear side or dose contradiction (dose ratio at least 1.8 or at most 0.56)
tiers.material: a smaller dose difference or a frequency difference
tiers.minor: a differential diagnosis, an investigation, or anything said that the record lacks

definition.provenance: every finding carries field_ai_filled from the record's own ai_field_metadata; a finding on an AI-filled field says so and is capped at material
definition.record: EMR_2_GENERATED, non-draft; the record named by the window's prescription uid, else the latest
definition.comparison: in code, field by field; drug names matched with the drug-match scorer behind its common-English and clinical-vocabulary gate
definition.bench_note: evr_perturb: one perturbation (add_drug, dose_x2, dose_half, laterality_swap, add_procedure, add_diagnosis, remove_drug) applied to a copy of a real record inside the job; recall per kind, extra findings, and the flag rate on unperturbed originals (originals are not negatives)
definition.engine_note: engine llm_zdr for the said-items extraction only; the Jev judgement hook is unwired
